mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product WHERE ctgId=#{ctgId} ORDER BY prdNo
SELECT * FROM product ORDER BY prdNo
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product(prdNo, prdName, prdPrice, prdCompany, prdStock, prdDescript, ctgId, minPlayer, maxPlayer, playTime, difficulty) VALUES((SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(prdNo)), 1000) + 1) FROM product), #{prdName}, #{prdPrice}, #{prdCompany, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prdStock}, #{prdDescript, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ctgId}, #{minPlayer}, #{maxPlayer}, #{playTime}, #{difficulty})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.*, NVL((SELECT SUM(op.ordQty) FROM order_product op WHERE op.prdNo=p.prdNo), 0) AS sold FROM product p ORDER BY sold DESC, p.prdNo DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 4
SELECT * FROM product WHERE UPPER(prdName) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(prdCompany) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ORDER BY prdNo
